title: Optimistic Verifiable Claims (OVC): Reproducibility Package
description: Smart contracts, measurement runners, archived transaction receipts and table/figure generation code for the revised version of the paper "Optimistic Verifiable Claims: A Blockchain Protocol for Conditionally Confidential Bidding in Decentralized Manufacturing" (arXiv:2607.25517). Version 4.0.0 executes the protocol on eighteen G-code files of the OpenGCode MultiSlicer Corpus v1.0.0 and projects the measurements onto Ethereum, Arbitrum and MegaETH, with transaction timing measured on their public testnets. Versions 1.0.0-3.0.0 belong to the first version of the paper.
